rules.rule: If comparing two pages on the same grid, check if text starts and stops at identical heights to confirm a once-decided system rather than independent layouts.
rules.evidence: Open any book at two random spreads and hold them side by side. The text starts at the same height on all four pages. It stops at the same height.

rules.rule: If assessing grid utility for content, count real ingredients first and build a grid that fits them rather than designing the grid before knowing the content.
rules.evidence: Designing the grid before knowing the content. Count the real ingredients first — headings, captions, sidebars, picture shapes — then build a grid that fits them
